title: Demystifying AI Platform Design for Distributed Inference of Next-Generation LLM models
authors: Abhimanyu Rajeshkumar Bambhaniya; Ritik Raj; Geonhwa Jeong; Souvik Kundu; Sudarshan Srinivasan; Suvinay Subramanian; Midhilesh Elavazhagan; Madhu Kumar; Tushar Krishna
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Meta, Intel Labs, Intel, Google

problem_statement.en: Designing AI platforms for LLM inference requires jointly reasoning about diverse model architectures (dense, GQA, MoE, Mamba), serving optimizations (chunked prefill, speculative decoding, quantization, KV pruning) and hardware design choices (HBM size, ICN bandwidth, parallelism), but no existing analytical tool spans this full design space across both prefill and decode.
problem_statement.zh: 為 LLM 推理設計 AI 平台需同時考量多樣的模型架構（dense、GQA、MoE、Mamba）、serving 優化（chunked prefill、speculative decoding、quantization、KV pruning）與硬體設計選擇（HBM 容量、ICN 頻寬、parallelism），但既有分析工具均無法在 prefill 與 decode 兩階段上覆蓋此完整設計空間。

key_innovation.en: GenZ, an analytical framework combining a Model Profiler, NPU Characterizer and Platform Characterizer; it uses a roofline-based per-operator model with measured efficiency factors to estimate TTFT/TPOT/latency/utilization/energy under TP+PP+EP parallelism with multi-level memory and ICN topologies, plus collective costs via ASTRA-sim integration.
key_innovation.zh: GenZ 是結合 Model Profiler、NPU Characterizer 與 Platform Characterizer 的分析式框架；採用 roofline-based 的 per-operator 模型與量測得到的效率因子，估算 TP+PP+EP 平行化下的 TTFT、TPOT、延遲、利用率與能耗，並透過整合 ASTRA-sim 估算 collective 通訊成本。

key_improvements.en: Validated against measurements on 8x NVIDIA H100, 2x A100, Intel Gaudi2, AMD MI300X and 8x Sambanova SN40L achieving a geomean error of 5.82% across architectures; prefill/decode geomean errors of 2.73% and 1.85% on NVIDIA platforms, 1.43% for chunked-prefill on 2x A100.
key_improvements.zh: 在 8x NVIDIA H100、2x A100、Intel Gaudi2、AMD MI300X 與 8x Sambanova SN40L 上驗證，跨架構幾何平均誤差為 5.82%；NVIDIA 平台 prefill 與 decode 的幾何平均誤差分別為 2.73% 與 1.85%，2x A100 上的 chunked-prefill 為 1.43%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA H100, NVIDIA A100, NVIDIA V100, AMD MI300X, Intel Gaudi2, Sambanova SN40L, HBM
gpu_count: Up to 8x H100, 2x A100, 1x MI300X, 1x Gaudi2, 8x SN40L
models_validated: Llama-2-7B, Llama-2-13B, Llama-3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B, Llama-3.1-70B, OPT-175B, Mixtral-8x22B, GPT-3, Gemma-2-2B/27B, Mamba

scope_assumptions.en: Assumes static load-balanced expert routing for MoE prefill; non-overlapping compute and collectives by default; efficiency factors derived from A100 runtimes and extrapolated; does not model dynamic expert imbalance, dynamic batching, or training workloads.
scope_assumptions.zh: MoE prefill 階段假設 expert 路由靜態且負載均衡；預設 compute 與 collective 不重疊；效率因子源自 A100 量測並外推；不建模動態 expert 不均、動態 batching 或訓練負載。
